jobs.name: vpin-daily-compute
jobs.prompt:
Run the VPIN (Volume-Synchronized Probability of Informed Trading) daily computation for monitoring crypto order flow toxicity.

Use the trading-ml venv (source ~/.hermes/venvs/trading-ml/bin/activate) and run:
  cd /home/frank/sycode-trading
  python execution/vpin_calculator.py --symbols BTCUSDT,ETHUSDT,SOLUSDT,XRPUSDT,BNBUSDT --timeframe 5m --lookback 60 --buckets 50 --window 50 --calibrate

Report:
1. Current VPIN values for each symbol (latest bar)
2. Any ENTRY signals detected (VPIN > 0.113 AND Volume Z > 2)
3. Trends in VPIN over the past week (rising/falling)
4. Calibration comparison with historical baseline

Read and summarize the combined summary JSON from /home/frank/trading-data/vpin/vpin_combined_5m.json and the calibration file from /home/frank/trading-data/vpin/vpin_calibration_5m.json after the run completes. Deliver a clean daily briefing.
